fact: The World Bank restructuring paper for the Supporting Egypt Education Reform Project says MOETE has developed the Smart Card 'Student Digital Identity', which integrates data from the EMIS and includes teacher assignments, test scores, digital attendance, school enrolment, digital course participation and biometrics; as of 12 June 2025 it was confined to the pilot governorate of Suez, the cards had been developed but not received by students, distribution to a first batch was scheduled for mid-2025, and a national rollout plan was expected by October 2025, the work being paid for from the Bank loan's DLI 10.
title: Restructuring Paper on a Proposed Project Restructuring of Supporting Egypt Education Reform Project (Report No: RES00419)
